variants.name: .454 Casull
variants.info: Chambers your Mateba Autorevolver in .454 Casull - giving it a massive increase in stopping power up close at the cost of having a lower rate of fire, increased recoil, and slightly worse handling.

variants.name: Tracerless
variants.info:
Ammo that doesn't have the components that create weapon tracers.

Greater overall accuracy for less range performance and bullet penetration.

variants.name: Armor Piercing
variants.info:
Changes your ammunition to green tipped armor piercing rounds.
Increases bullet penetration (+30%) and torso damage multiplier (+5%) but reduces damage up close (-5%) range (-5%) and head damage multiplier (-4%).

variants.name: .44 Special
variants.info:
Specialty ammo made for the .44 magnum caliber with the intent of more controllable power.
Less recoil results in greater accuracy, however poorer ranges in exchange for retaining damage.

variants.name: Hollow Point
variants.info:
Changes your ammunition to hollow point rounds.
Increases damage up close (+15%), maximum damage range (+17.5%)!
But reduces torso multiplier (-15%), penetration (-62.5%) and bullet speed (-10%).
